    min_cost = float('inf')
    # Initialize the list to store the operations
    operations = []
    
    # Function to calculate the cost of swapping to sort the permutation
    def calculate_cost(P):
        cost = 0
        for i in range(N):
            for j in range(i + 1, N):
                if P[i] > P[j]:
                    cost += abs(i - j)
        return cost

            # Swap P[i] and P[j]

            # Calculate the cost of the current permutation
            current_cost = calculate_cost(P)
            # If the current cost is less than the minimum cost found so far
            if current_cost < min_cost:
                min_cost = current_cost
                operations = [(i + 1, j + 1)]
            # If the current cost is equal to the minimum cost found so far

                operations.append((i + 1, j + 1))
            # Swap back P[i] and P[j] to restore the original permutation
            P[i], P[j] = P[j], P[i]
    
    # Return the minimum total cost and the operations
    return min_cost, operations
